prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a tattooed individual holding an open book, possibly a directory or reference manual, with both hands. The person’s forearms and hands are prominently featured, adorned with intricate tattoos and a chunky silver bracelet, as well as a large wristwatch. The book’s pages are filled with columns of numbers and text, suggesting a technical or archival nature. The subject wears a white, textured, short-sleeved shirt, and the focus is on the hands and book, with the background softly blurred, revealing hints of a wooden shelf and indistinct objects, lending a domestic or office setting. The color palette is muted and natural, with soft daylight illuminating the scene, creating gentle shadows and a calm, contemplative mood. The composition uses shallow depth of field to draw attention to the tactile details of the hands, tattoos, and book, evoking a sense of quiet focus and personal history.
